free_tier.stated: Storage optimized VPS gives you a Linux CLI environment, static networking, 10Gbps shared port access, and a simple path from 1TB to 32TB of storage capacity.

egress.terms: Metered per slice: 'Each storage VPS slice adds 1TB SATA storage, 2GB memory, 2TB transfer'. A 2:1 ratio. At 10 slices = 10 TB storage and only 20 TB/mo transfer. Below the 30 TB/mo serving requirement. Overage rate not published on the page.

limits_note: Slice count adds RAM and cores linearly, which is wasted spend for pure storage. 10 Gbps shared port. The traffic ratio is the binding constraint, not the price.
reliability_note: Long-established US host (Secaucus/LA). The $3/TB headline is genuine and linear — 10 slices is $30 for 10 TB, no discount, no cliff. Page served a 403 and was retrieved via the provider renderer.
confidence_note: the 1TB-to-32TB storage ladder and the per-slice SATA, memory, transfer and price are stated on the Storage VPS page
